windows_bcp.notes: BCP 0.7.0 adds offline-first mission stall detection and bounded durable resume intents while preserving low-resource lifecycle, telemetry, Telegram watchdog, and hash-pinned self-update.

android_b_edge.notes: B-EDGE 2.1.0 secondary-sentinel source candidate. Distribution remains intentionally disabled until a same-identity signed APK is produced and verified; installed 2.0.0-rc1 remains authoritative on the old phone.

nexus.notes: Nexus 0.1.10 targets the actual PC failure: esbuild npm postinstall. Managed Wrangler installs with --ignore-scripts, verifies the packaged @esbuild/win32-x64 binary, then runs wrangler.js directly under pinned portable Node. Failed partial package trees are removed before bounded retry. Exact Windows path is exercised in CI before field promotion.
